body.statement: Can a single data-driven confidence set based on the transition-experiment and ordered-modulus handle cover \(\psi_{\delta_n}\) uniformly over local sequences approaching both hardening boundaries, with oracle-order expected length on each separated branch; or must every honest procedure pay a logarithmic length factor determined by simultaneous uncertainty in \(\kappa\), \(\rho\), and \(H\)?
body.justification: Separated-regime validity does not answer what an analyst should do when the estimated normalizer places the multiplier near a transition.
body.gap: HeilerKazak2021Irregular adapts between regular and stable laws for a fixed target, whereas this problem has two transitions, a moving target, and an intermediate marked family.
body.consumer: A resolution would permit one automatic hardening diagnostic and interval in software without user-supplied regime labels.
